# None of (`not`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Logic · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

True when none of the nested conditions is true.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `conditions` | list of conditions | yes |  | None of these may be true. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: not
    conditions:
      - type: app_running
        app: obs64.exe
```
